chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Zurara, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There are three things; if the Believer knows them, they will result in an increase in his lifespan and the continuation of blessings upon him.' So I said, 'And what are they?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'His prolonging his bowing and prostration in his prayer, and his prolonging his sitting with his food when he is feeding others at his table, and his doing kindness to his family.'
ai.seo_question: What are the three actions that increase a believer's lifespan and blessings according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links physical acts of worship and social etiquette to the metaphysical concept of 'bada'' (divine alteration of destiny), suggesting that prolonged humility in prayer and generosity in hosting can literally extend one's lifespan. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the interplay between ritual precision (such as the depth of ruku' and sujud) and social cohesion (ikram al-nafs) as means to sustain divine favor (ni'mah). The inclusion of family kindness highlights the domestic sphere as a primary site for accumulating spiritual merit and longevity.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘There are three things, if the Believer were to know these, it would result in an increase in his life span, and a lasting for the Bounties upon him’. So I said, ‘And what are these?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘His prolongation in his Bowings and his Prostrations in his Prayer, and his prolongation in his sitting upon his meal when he is feeding (others) upon his table spread, and his performing of the act of kindness upon his family’.
en.sarwar: 15. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘There are three things which would help lengthen his life if a believing person comes to know them and make his wealth more durable.’

I then asked, ‘What are those things?’ The Imam replied, ‘They are remaining in Ruku’ for a long time, as well as in his Sajdah during prayer (Salat), his sitting for a long time on the table when feeding people, and those providing Benevolent Assistance to properly deserving people.’”
